title: The etale projection mate has the normalized pro-etale counit transpose
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p
e\ell$; let $ ar X$ and $Y$ be separated schemes of finite type over $k$ and $p: ar X	o Y$ a proper $k$-morphism [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $A	o B$ be a homomorphism of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$. On the small étale and pro-étale sites use the ordinary uncompleted constant-ring module derived categories and the exact comparison pullbacks $
u_T^*$, with $
u_T^{-1}A_{T,\mathrm{et}}=A_T$ and $
u_T^{-1}B_{T,\mathrm{et}}=B_T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]; on both sites use the derived adjunctions with counits $\varepsilon^{e}$ and $\varepsilon^{p}$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and regard $B$ as an $A$-module. Let $K\in D^+( ar X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ be such that $H=K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A}B_{ ar X,\mathrm{et}}$ (étale derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]) also lies in $D^+( ar X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, and put $N=
u_{ ar X}^*K$. Let $ eta_K:
u_Y^*Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}K\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_{*}N$ and $ eta_H:
u_Y^*Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}H\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_*
u_{ ar X}^*H$ be the canonical normalized comparison isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate] for $u=p$ and $\Lambda=A$, and identify $
u_{ ar X}^*H\simeq N\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A}B_{ ar X}$ and $
u_Y^*(Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AB_{Y,\mathrm{et}})\simeq
u_Y^*Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AB_Y$ by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Let
$$\pi_K:Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AB_{Y,\mathrm{et}}\longrightarrow Rp_{\mathrm{et},*} igl(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AB_{ ar X,\mathrm{et}} igr)$$
be the étale projection morphism of [def-kun-projection-formula-map] (with $E=K$ and coefficient object $B_{Y,\mathrm{et}}$, $p^{-1}B_{Y,\mathrm{et}}=B_{ ar X,\mathrm{et}}$), and define the $A$-linear pro-étale map
$$t= eta_H\circ
u_Y^*(\pi_K)\circ( eta_K^{-1}\otimes^{\mathbf L}1):Rp_*N\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AB_Y\longrightarrow Rp_* igl(N\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AB_{ ar X} igr).$$
Then the adjoint transpose of $t$ under $p^*\dashv Rp_*$ on $A$-modules, composed with the tensor-pullback identification $p^*(Rp_*N\otimes^{\mathbf L}B_Y)\simeq p^*Rp_*N\otimes^{\mathbf L}B_{ ar X}$, is $\varepsilon^p_N\otimes^{\mathbf L}1_{B_{ ar X}}$. In particular $t$ is an isomorphism whenever $\pi_K$ is.

source.place: Step 1, mate calculation identifying the canonical comparison with the finite-window etale projection

proof.text:
Use the square of ringed topoi with top row $
u_{ ar X}: ar X_{\mathrm{proet}}	o ar X_{\mathrm{et}}$, bottom row $
u_Y$, and vertical maps $p_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and $p_{\mathrm{et}}$. The ring at each corner is the ordinary constant sheaf $A$. The site comparison is a geometric morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]; its commutation with inverse image is the canonical comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback]. The structure-ring identifications are the constant-section-preserving ones of [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map] and those stipulated for $
u$ in the statement, so this is a square of ringed topoi, not just of underlying categories. Put $C=
u_Y^*$, $D=
u_{ ar X}^*$, $l=p_{\mathrm{et}}^{-1}$, $r=Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}$, $L=p_{\mathrm{proet}}^*$, $R=Rp_*$, and $Q=B_{Y,\mathrm{et}}[0]$. The canonical comparison $a:Dl\simeq LC$ is the one in [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate]. The exchange map for this square is the mate of $a^{-1}$: its transpose at $J$ is $D(\varepsilon^e_J)a_{rJ}^{-1}$. Thus on $J=K,H$ it is exactly $ eta_J$, by that node's definition and normalization; this identifies the named maps, without choosing an arbitrary isomorphism. Both $K$ and $H$ satisfy its $D^+$ domain by hypothesis.

source.place: Tag 0E48, remark-compatible-with-diagram; equation-projection-formula-map, with Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product

proof.text:
Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-exchange-tensor-coherence] to this square, with its $f=p_{\mathrm{et}}$, $f'=p_{\mathrm{proet}}$, $g=\nu_Y$, $g'=\nu_{\bar X}$, $E=K$ and coefficient object $Q$. This theorem permits a commutative ringed square without cartesianness, on unbounded module derived categories, so it applies to these small sites and ordinary constant-ring modules. Its tensor identifications are those of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], exactly the identifications fixed in the statement. Let $\Pi:RN\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B_Y\to R(N\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B_{\bar X})$ denote the pro-etale projection map defined in the coherence theorem as the adjunct of the tensor counit. The etale projection there is $\pi_K$ by [def-kun-projection-formula-map]. Since $lQ=B_{\bar X,\mathrm{et}}$ and $CQ=B_Y$, the theorem's equality, after its specified tensor and composition identifications and Step 1's identification of exchange components, reads
$$\beta_H\circ C(\pi_K)=\Pi\circ(\beta_K\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}1).$$
The target identification includes $R(DH)\simeq R(N\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B_{\bar X})$, so both sides have exactly that common target.

source.place: Tag 0E48, remark-compatible-with-diagram; equation-projection-formula-map, with Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product

proof.text:
Precompose Step 2's equality by $\beta_K^{-1}\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}1$. Tensor is a bifunctor, so $(\beta_K\otimes1)(\beta_K^{-1}\otimes1)=1$. The resulting left side is the specified $t$ and the right side is $\Pi$. By the definition of $\Pi$ in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-exchange-tensor-coherence], its transpose is
$$\varepsilon^p_{N\otimes^{\mathbf L}B_{\bar X}}\circ L(t)
 =(\varepsilon^p_N\otimes^{\mathbf L}1)\circ c_{RN,B_Y},$$
where $c_{RN,B_Y}:L(RN\otimes^{\mathbf L}B_Y)\xrightarrow{\sim}LRN\otimes^{\mathbf L}B_{\bar X}$ is the tensor-pullback identification of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. In particular, precomposing this transpose by $c_{RN,B_Y}^{-1}$ gives exactly $\varepsilon^p_N\otimes^{\mathbf L}1$, as claimed.

source.place: Tag 0E48, remark-compatible-with-diagram; equation-projection-formula-map, with Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product

proof.text:
If $\pi_K$ is invertible, the inverse of $t$, in the same tensor identifications, is
$$(\beta_K\otimes^{\mathbf L}1)\circ C(\pi_K^{-1})\circ\beta_H^{-1}.$$
Indeed each composite with $t$ reduces to an identity by functoriality of $C$ and of tensor, followed by the two inverse identities for each $\beta$ and for $\pi_K$. The comparison components are invertible by [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate] on the two bounded-below objects $K,H$. No assertion that $\pi_K$ is always invertible has been used.

Steps 3 (cancel beta_K, transpose of Pi from its definition) and 4 (explicit inverse) are elementary. The transpose clause is correctly typed as tau∘c^{-1} = eps_N⊗1. Edge cases checked: p=id, K=0, empty X̄, B=A, B=0. No duplicate among the projection/exchange nodes of proper-base-change and six-functors. lean.statement: theorem directImageEtaleMate (ell p : ℕ) (_hell : ell.Prime) (_hp : 0 < p) (_hne : p ≠ ell) (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p] {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B] (_hA : ∃ n : ℕ, (ell : A) ^ n = 0) (_hB : ∃ n : ℕ, (ell : B) ^ n = 0) (a : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper f] (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) (hK : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus K) (hH : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus (((directImageEtaleMateEtaleTensor A X).obj K).obj ((directImageEtaleMateEtalePullback A f).obj (directImageEtaleMateCoefficient a Y)))) : (directImageEtaleMatePullbackTensor f ((directImageEtaleMateProEtalePushforward A f).obj ((directImageEtaleMateComparison A X).obj K)) ((directImageEtaleMateComparison A Y).obj (directImageEtaleMateCoefficient a Y))).inv ≫ ((directImageEtaleMateAdjunction A f).homEquiv _ _).symm (directImageEtaleMateTransport f K (directImageEtaleMateCoefficient a Y) hK hH) = ((directImageEtaleMateProEtaleTensor A X).map ((directImageEtaleMateAdjunction A f).counit.app ((directImageEtaleMateComparison A X).obj K))).app ((directImageEtaleMateProEtalePullback A f).obj ((directImageEtaleMateComparison A Y).obj (directImageEtaleMateCoefficient a Y))) ∧ (IsIso (directImageEtaleMateProjection f K (directImageEtaleMateCoefficient a Y)) → IsIso (directImageEtaleMateTransport f K (directImageEtaleMateCoefficient a Y) hK hH))
